_note: USD per million tokens, list price (standard tier). Provider prices change: verify before relying on an estimate, and pass --prices <file> to override or add models. A model with no entry here or in --prices makes the run refuse to start rather than be priced at zero. Matching is the exact id, or a dated snapshot of it (<id>-YYYYMMDD or <id>@...); any other variant is unpriced, including OpenAI's dashed-date snapshots (<id>-YYYY-MM-DD) and -pro/-mini variants. Only the OpenAI ids listed under sources.openai are bundled; supply other providers with --prices.

openai.tier: Standard, text tokens, USD per 1M tokens
